verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a support article title about backing up a BitLocker recovery key. That implies Windows has built-in disk encryption with a recovery mechanism. Nothing in the pack says the encryption is TPM-backed or uses hardware encryption, and nothing shows how a power user would turn it on or configure it. Missing for 10: any mention of TPM integration, hardware-backed key protection, documentation on enabling or configuring encryption, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
